select (select count(*) from removed)::int as removed, (select count(*) from inserted)::int as inserted;

-- Removes all demo messages. Real messages are not touched.
delete from support_messages where session_id like 'demo:%';

parameters.content:
## Saltgrove – Demo Data
Run before recording. Both resets are safe to run again.
- **Reset Demo Messages:** one made-up day (32 messages) in support_messages for the daily report. Every demo row has session_id 'demo:…' and execution_id 'demo'.
- **Reset Demo Orders:** the 15 made-up orders, with tracking times counted back from now. SG-10237 and SG-10241 belong to the demo buyer, Jordan Ellis.

To remove the demo messages: enable "Remove Demo Messages", disable "Reset Demo Messages", run once.

  items = excluded.items,
  order_total_usd = excluded.order_total_usd,
